subdimensions.name: Blind Spot Mitigation

evidence.quote: In February 2026, the government approved a new state program to strengthen penalties for violence against women and children, improve enforcement, expand support services, and introduce measurable benchmarks. subdimensions.name: Signal Amplification
subdimensions.justification: Low-power voices are silenced at the extreme: the UN found blogger Valijon Kalonov's psychiatric detention arbitrary and he remained detained.

evidence.quote: On February 28, 2025, the UN Working Group on Arbitrary Detention ruled that blogger Valijon Kalonov's psychiatric hospitalization was unfounded and arbitrary, yet he remained detained at time of reporting.
